principle: Read broadly, verify narrowly, publish only with source trace and human approval.

sources.name: CNN

sources.contentUse: headline, market context, public metadata and link; no paywall bypass or full-text storage

sources.contentUse: public summary and link by default; archive or syndication only under licence

sources.contentUse: headline, metadata, short internal summary and link; no paywall bypass

sources.name: BBC News
sources.contentUse: headline, short summary, metadata and link

sources.name: Official institutions, regulators and registries
sources.contentUse: facts, filings, decisions, datasets and citations according to source terms

sources.name: Stock exchanges, central banks and market authorities
sources.contentUse: quotes and market data with provider, timestamp, currency, delay and licence metadata

cadence.markets: every 60 minutes during relevant market sessions

verificationRules: important claims require an official or primary source where available
fast-changing or sensitive claims require at least two independent sources
market prices must include provider, timestamp, currency and delay
conflicting sources must remain visibly unresolved until reviewed
opinion and analysis must be separated from reported fact
no item becomes operational knowledge without verification status

prohibited: storage or republication of unauthorised full articles
using unverified reporting as a binding investment or legal decision
exposing credentials, subscriptions or tokens to workflow profiles
rightsAndSafety.publicOutput: Original group analysis may cite and link to sources. Any quotation must be short, necessary, attributed and within applicable rights.
rightsAndSafety.audit: Every collected item, model-generated summary, correction and approval decision is logged.
